acceptance: Require complete identical acquisition coverage and unchanged component geometry, identity, pose and motion. Confirmed-alarm frames, alarm episodes and unknown frames must not increase for full corpus or either predeclared partition. No default promotion solely from an empty-corpus pass.
temporal_protocol: One uninterrupted detector per variant; no reset at database or development/evaluation boundaries. Metrics sliced by original record timestamps. Partition episodes restart at partition boundaries and are not additive.
